sources.snippet: Description NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Bolt 74B-A9B 24GB is a vision-language model (VLM) designed to run everyday agentic tasks locally, using a native 2-bit quantization to fit in 24GB of memory and run alongside other applications. sources.snippet: We are releasing NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Bolt 74B-A9B 24GB, a Mixture-of-Experts hybrid Mamba-Transformer model designed to run everyday agentic tasks locally on NVIDIA RTX/DGX Spark.

sources.title: Nemotron AI Models | NVIDIA Developer
sources.snippet: NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Lightning for Fast, Specialized Agent Tasks NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Lightning is an open 30B MoE model with 3B active parameters for specialized tasks in always-on agents. With NeMo Switchyard, developers can route high-volume execution to Lightning when it's the right fit, while reserving frontier models for complex planning.

sources.title: NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Bolt 74B-A9B 24GB - SourceForge.net
sources.snippet: NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Bolt 74B-A9B 24GB is an open-weight multimodal AI model optimized for running autonomous agents on systems with 24GB of GPU memory. Derived from Nemotron 3.5 Super VL through NVIDIA's Star Elastic compression method, it features 74B total parameters with approximately 9B activated per token.
